name: TWO_SERVANTS
canonical: the two young servants of Abraham left at the mountain's foot, a pair of lean ancient Hebrew youths with sun-browned skin and short dark beards, clad in coarse undyed wool tunics girded with rope and simple head-cloths, waiting beside a tethered grey donkey on the barren rocky ground below
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
